scope: Spain national feasibility; inventory and measurements only

sources.provider: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico
sources.geometry_role: none unless an independent geometry is available

access.bulk_format: XML export in blocks of at most 50000 PIF records
access.measurement: count-only public queries by year; no national XML downloaded

sources.coverage_warning: The search currently exposes records through 2023. Zero rows for 2024-2025 do not prove that no fires occurred and are not a publication-status statement.

license.attribution: Origen de los datos: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico.

sources.update_model: controlled snapshot after definitive records become available

sources.provider: Clara Ochoa, Emilio Chuvieco, Marcos Rodrigues and Magí Franquesa
sources.coverage: mainland Spain; nominally burned areas over 5 ha
sources.method: Landsat, nominal 30 m, documented remote sensing product

measured_geometry.territory_relation_method: positive-area intersection with official IGN/CNIG boundaries; largest overlap is primary only for diagnostic counts; no clipping

sources.provider: Copernicus Emergency Management Service / European Commission Joint Research Centre
sources.role: recent provisional layer, not an administrative fire inventory
sources.method: Rapid Damage Assessment using MODIS 250 m and, since 2018, Sentinel-2 20 m; dates need not be ignition/extinction dates
sources.access: territorial snapshot intersected with an official boundary
sources.update_model: dated periodic snapshots; never silently replace prior provenance

sources.role: canonical autonomous-community, province and municipality codes and names
sources.history_requirement: preserve annual dictionaries and documented changes; do not force historical municipalities into current ones

sources.provider: Instituto Geográfico Nacional / Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica
sources.role: territory relations and bounds, not fire geometry

egif_1968_2023.basis: linear per-record extrapolation from the audited Valencian 1968-1992 pipeline; planning estimate, not a downloaded national snapshot

non_equivalence: EGIF record is not automatically a unique physical fire episode.
ESFire30 polygon is not automatically an EGIF record or an official autonomous perimeter.
EFFIS polygon is a provisional satellite detection and not a complete administrative inventory.
Independent sources coexist; source replacement only changes preferred display geometry, never provenance history.
